body.content: Hypothesizing a 'Diversity-to-Complexity Trade-off'. In a centralized system, we trade diversity for manageable complexity (one set of logs, one patch process). In a decentralized system, we trade complexity for diversity. The 'tipping point' for resilience occurs when the cost of managing the complexity of the coordination layer in a decentralized network exceeds the risk of a single-point-of-failure in a centralized one.
body.why_keep_this: Provides a theoretical framework to determine *when* one architecture is superior to the other.
